ORDINANCE III OF 2023
SUGAR FACTORIES (CONTROL) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2023
An Ordinance to amend the Sugar Factories
(Control) Act, 1950
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
19th April, 2023]
No.
Legis:13-86/2001(P-II), dated 19.4.2023.---The following Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is
hereby published for general information:
It
is necessary to amend the Sugar Factories (Control) Act, 1950 (XXII of 1950) for
expeditious disposal of appeals and the matters ancillary thereto and connected
therewith.
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be cited as the Sugar Factories (Control) (Amendment) Ordinance,
2023.
(2) This
Ordinance shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 13-A of Act XXII of 1950
